title: [LOGGED OUT] Header links show a visible focus ring when reached with the keyboard
reason: All answers match. Store link reached with 3 Tab presses and shows a blue focus outline.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded (first screenshot showed skeleton loading; waited 3 s until readyState complete, then screenshot taken). Cookie banner shown.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner was shown; clicked Dismiss. Screenshot shows the button in loading state, banner was gone right after.

steps.text: Press the Tab key until the "Store" link in the header has the keyboard focus (at most 10 times).
steps.saw: Pressed Tab 3 times: LUDUS logo, Home, Store.

steps.text: Does the "Store" link have the keyboard focus?
steps.saw: document.activeElement is the A link "Store" (href /store), matches :focus-visible.

steps.text: Is a visible focus outline or ring shown around the "Store" link?
steps.saw: A blue/white rectangular outline is shown around Store (computed outline: auto 1px rgb(0, 95, 204)).
